entries.zh: 保护；护卫（如天主之护佑，如军队之护卫城池）
entries.en: to protect, guard; to shield (as God protects, as the militia guards the city)

entries.zh: 庇佑；保佑（神明庇护）
entries.en: to bless, protect; to give divine aid and favor

entries.zh: 为；相帮、护助（“相为”义：帮衬、照应他人）
entries.en: to help, shelter, favor; to stand by someone, back them up

entries.zh: 协（恊，协之异体）；合力、协力相助
entries.en: to join forces; to help by combining strength

entries.zh: 协力同心；齐心合力相助
entries.en: to join forces with one heart; to labor together in unity

entries.zh: 护；护助、救护（护人解难）
entries.en: to protect; to help, remedy (succor in need)

entries.zh: 帮；帮衬、帮办（助人任事当差）
entries.en: to help, assist; to aid one engaged in a task or office

entries.zh: 帮贴；出钱资助、贴补
entries.en: to help with money; to subsidize, contribute jointly
entries.notes: 原稿音写第二字声调污损（T99），照例降为低置信；汉字与西栏互证（出钱帮补）本身仍清晰。

entries.zh: 救；救助、解救（使人脱离危难）
entries.en: to save, rescue; to deliver, liberate

entries.zh: 救济；施济、赈济贫乏
entries.en: to relieve with alms; to give charity to the needy

entries.zh: 救护；援救而护助
entries.en: to rescue and protect; to give aid and shelter

entries.zh: 救急；济人之急（急难时出手相助）
entries.en: to help in time of necessity; to succor urgently or perforce

entries.zh: 救应；闻呼驰援、接应救助
entries.en: to go to the rescue when called; to reinforce, back up

entries.zh: 来救；前来救援（首字来/求原稿存疑）
entries.en: to come to the rescue; to succor, deliver
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注来/求存疑：西栏救助义与官话对音倾向「来救」，音写首音亦近「求」，两可之间。

entries.zh: 卫；保卫、护卫（防御护持）
entries.en: to guard, defend; to protect

entries.zh: 资；资助、供给
entries.en: to aid, supply; to furnish means

entries.zh: 资身；资给其身、助人养身立身
entries.en: to support a person materially; to provide for one (help someone)

entries.zh: 赞；襄助、协助（助其劳作）
entries.en: to assist, help; to aid someone at work or cultivation

entries.zh: 赞言；进言相助、代为关说
entries.en: to help by interceding; to speak in someone's behalf

entries.zh: 赞口；以口相助、口头帮衬
entries.en: to help with words; to back someone verbally

entries.zh: 赞成；助成、襄助其事（此处取17世纪助成义，非现代赞同义）
entries.en: to help bring about, assist in accomplishing; to intercede

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（ayudara n del gr stinien 无法展开），与「占」字（占卜、占据义）无法互证，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 保庇；神明庇佑（天主护佑圣徒）
entries.en: (of God) to bless and shelter; to protect the saints

entries.zh: 保祐；神佑、上天保佑（如天主施佑）
entries.en: to bless, protect (as God does); to grant divine protection
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注祐/佑字形存疑；两字同义（保佑），语义不受影响，仅字形待考。
